scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @foode/shared build && pnpm --filter @foode/db build && pnpm --filter @foode/ui build
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: pnpm db:migrations:validate && pnpm --filter @foode/db migrations:sync-supabase && pnpm supabase db push --linked
scripts.test:quality: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @foode/api test:quality && pnpm --filter @foode/admin test && pnpm --filter @foode/web test && pnpm --filter @foode/shared test && pnpm --filter @foode/ui test && pnpm --filter @foode/db test
